notes.title: Multi-user matchmaking in GitHub browser, Invite-only cloud integration
notes.content:
GitHub browser now supports multi-user matchmaking
- Select: Connect to photon0.primitive.io to connect to matchmaking server
- When a user lands on a GitHub repository, they will be able to see and speak with other users who are on the same repository in the GitHub graph

Invite-only cloud integration
- Connect to Bitbucket, GitHub private, GitLab and see your own code and revision history
- After completing setup on https://cloud-beta.primitive.io, select "Switch to private repos" and enter pin code

For requests to join the cloud beta, please email: support@primitive.io
